attacks.name: Sleep Pulse
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

cards.name: Zoroark

attacks.name: Nasty Plot
attacks.text: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Foul Play
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack.

cards.flavorText: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

cards.name: Axew

attacks.name: Dragon Rage
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If either of them is tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.

cards.name: Pansage

attacks.name: Bullet Seed
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are know to relieve stress.

cards.name: Zorua

attacks.name: Jump On
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 more damage.

cards.flavorText: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Minccino
cards.flavorText: They greet one another by rubbing each other with their tails, which are always kept well groomed and clean.

cards.name: Pansage

attacks.name: Bullet Seed
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Pidove
cards.flavorText: Each follows its Trainer's orders as best it can, but they sometimes fail to understand complicated commands.

cards.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Fairy Power
attacks.text: Return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it in your hand.

cards.flavorText: With its acute hearing, it can pick up sounds from far away. It usually hides in quiet places.

cards.name: Deoxys

attacks.name: Cell Storm
attacks.text: Discard 2 Psychic Energy attached to Deoxys and remove 6 damage counters from Deoxys.

cards.flavorText: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

cards.name: Dialga

attacks.name: Time Rewind
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.

cards.name: Espeon

attacks.name: Solar Suggestion
attacks.text: Move up to 4 damage counters from any of your Pokémon to any of your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

attacks.name: Psybeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.

cards.name: Forretress

attacks.name: Mirror Shot
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Everyone Explode Now
attacks.text: Does 30 damage times the number of Pineco and Forretress you have in play. This attack does 30 damage to each of your Pineco and Forretress in play.

cards.flavorText: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

cards.name: Groudon

attacks.name: Volcano Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard the top 4 cards of your opponent's deck. If tails, discard the top 4 cards of your deck.

cards.flavorText: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

cards.name: Gyarados

attacks.name: Hyper Beam
attacks.text: Discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

cards.name: Hitmontop

attacks.name: Triple Kick
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Close Combat
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Hitmontop by attacks is increased by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.

cards.name: Ho-Oh

attacks.name: Scorching Wing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Fire Energy attached to Ho-Oh.

cards.flavorText: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven-colored wings.

cards.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Fire Counterattack
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Fighting Pokémon in play, this attack does 20 damage plus 60 more damage.

attacks.name: Dark Roar
attacks.text: Your opponent discards a card from his or her hand.

cards.flavorText: Upon hearing its eerie howls, other Pokémon get the shivers and head straight back to their nests.

cards.name: Jirachi

abilities.name: Stardust Song
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Jirachi from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip 3 coins. For each heads, search your discard pile for a Psychic Energy card and attach it to Jirachi.

attacks.name: Time Hollow
attacks.text: Choose a number of your opponent's Stage 1 or Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon up to the amount of Energy attached to Jirachi. Remove the highest Stage Evolution card from each of those Pokémon and put those cards back into your opponent's hand.

cards.flavorText: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.

cards.name: Kyogre

attacks.name: Destructive Tsunami
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage to each of your opponent's Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 40 damage to each of your Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

cards.name: Leafeon

attacks.name: Miasma Wind
attacks.text: Does 50 damage times the number of Special Conditions affecting the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sooting Scent
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: When you see Leafeon asleep in a patch of sunshine, you'll know it is using photosynthesis to produce clean air.

cards.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Dimension Sphere
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each of your Pokémon in the Lost Zone.

attacks.name: Sky Uppercut
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

cards.flavorText: It's said that no foe can remain invisible to Lucario, since it can detect auras. Even foes it could not otherwise see.

cards.name: Lugia

attacks.name: Linear Attack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.

cards.name: Magmortar

attacks.name: Hard Crush
attacks.text: Discard the top 3 cards from your deck. This attack does 50 damage times the number of Energy cards you discarded.

attacks.name: Mantle Bazooka
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Magmortar.

cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit out of its arms. Its breath also sears and sizzles.

cards.name: Ninetales

abilities.name: Roast Reveal
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a Fire Energy from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards. This power can't be used if Ninetales is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: Its nine beautiful tails are filled with a wondrous energy that could keep it alive for 1,000 years.

cards.name: Pachirisu

abilities.name: Self-Generation
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Pachirisu from your hand onto your Bench, you may attach up to 2 Lightning Energy cards from your hand to Pachirisu.

attacks.name: Shocking Bolt
attacks.text: Put all Energy cards attached to Pachirisu in the Lost Zone.

cards.flavorText: It's one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.

cards.name: Palkia

attacks.name: Wormhole
attacks.text: Switch Palkia with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.

cards.name: Rayquaza

attacks.name: Inferno Spear
attacks.text: Discard a Fire Energy and a Lightning Energy attached to Rayquaza.

cards.flavorText: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

cards.name: Smeargle

abilities.name: Portrait
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Smeargle is your Active Pokémon, you may look at your opponent's hand. If you do, choose a Supporter card you find there and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. This power can't be used if Smeargle is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tail Rap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Once it becomes an adult, it has a tendency to let its comrades plant footprints on its back.

cards.name: Umbreon

attacks.name: Moonlight Fang
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, prevent all effects, including damage, done to Umbreon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon than has any Poké-Powers or Poké-Bodies.

attacks.name: Quick Blow
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

cards.name: Ampharos

attacks.name: Acceleration Bolt
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Thunder
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Ampharos does 20 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The tail's tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

cards.name: Cleffa

abilities.name: Sweet Sleeping Face
abilities.text: As long as Cleffa is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Cleffa by attacks.

attacks.name: Eeeeeeek
attacks.text: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 6 cards. Cleffa is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Team Magma's Numel

attacks.name: Ember
attacks.text: Discard an Energy attached to this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: No matter how heavy the cargo, we can transport it to our destination with ease, thanks to Numel.

cards.name: Team Magma's Camerupt

abilities.name: Burning Draft
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Fighting or Fire Energy card from your discard pile to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flame Ball
attacks.text: Move a basic Energy from this Pokémon to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Camerupt, with its strength against fire, played a big role in rescuing team members.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Spheal
cards.flavorText: Spheal's Water Gun can put out any fire. Flames used by opponents have no effect!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Sealeo

attacks.name: Splatter
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Hail Storm
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is a Team Magma Pokémon, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It provides support by making paths of ice. It can win any battle as long as it's on ice.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Walrein

attacks.name: Power Blow
attacks.text: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of Energy attached to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dual Blizzard
attacks.text: Discard 2 Water Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It's good at attacks that freeze opponents with a powerful cold snap. Then, it pulverizes a frozen foe with its sharp tusks!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Kyogre-EX
rules: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Power Saver
abilities.text: If there are 4 or fewer Team Aqua Pokémon in play, this Pokémon can't attack.

attacks.name: Aqua Impact
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Colorless in your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Grimer
cards.flavorText: Its flexible body, which allows it to squeeze into any cracks, comes in handy when invading enemy hideouts.

cards.name: Team Aqua's Muk

abilities.name: Sludge Festival
abilities.text: The Retreat Cost of each Pokémon in play (except for Team Aqua Pokémon) is Colorless more.

attacks.name: Pester
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It immobilizes its opponents by wrapping them in its huge, poisonous body. It'll smoosh you, too!

cards.name: Team Aqua's Seviper

attacks.name: Venomous Fang
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Venom Tail
attacks.text: If your opponent's Active Pokémon is affected by a Special Condition, discard an Energy attached to that Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Seviper's tail is a sharp blade. It can even poison you!

cards.name: Team Magma's Baltoy

attacks.name: Telekinesis
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

cards.flavorText: They all cry out at once to let us know when they spot an enemy. It really helps out!

cards.name: Team Magma's Claydol

abilities.name: Magma Switch
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may move a basic Energy from 1 of your Pokémon to 1 of your Team Magma Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Claydol's beam can seize opponents and keep them from moving. Long-range attacks are its specialty!

cards.name: Team Magma's Aron
cards.flavorText: Aron, which even devour metal, can eat and destroy enemy ships in an instant.

cards.name: Team Magma's Lairon

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: When Lairon uses Take Down, the impact from its solid body is enough to destroy concrete!

cards.name: Team Magma's Aggron

attacks.name: Rock Stomp
attacks.text: Discard as many Fighting Energy attached to your Pokémon as you like. This attack does 40 damage times the amount of Fighting Energy you discarded.

attacks.name: Boulder Storm
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Aggron's metal horns can smash through any defenses, no matter how strong!

cards.name: Bulbasaur

attacks.name: Find a Friend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

cards.flavorText: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.

cards.name: Ludicolo

abilities.name: Table Service
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Punch and Run
attacks.text: Switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

cards.name: Morelull

attacks.name: Sleep Spore
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.

cards.name: Charmander

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charizard

attacks.name: Wild Tackle
attacks.text: This Pokémon does 50 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.

cards.name: Arcanine

abilities.name: Security Guard
abilities.text: As long as this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, all of your Pokémon take 30 less damage from your opponent's attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.

cards.name: Psyduck

attacks.name: Panic
attacks.text: This Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Magikarp

attacks.name: Hold Still
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.

cards.name: Greninja

abilities.name: Evasion Jutsu
abilities.text: If any damage is done to this Pokémon by attacks, flip a coin. If heads, prevent that damage.

attacks.name: Furious Shurikens
attacks.text: This attack does 50 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.

cards.name: Detective Pikachu

attacks.name: Scout
attacks.text: Your opponent reveals their hand.

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.

cards.name: Mr. Mime

abilities.name: Pantomime
abilities.text: When you play this Pokémon from your hand onto your Bench during your turn, you may switch 1 of your face-down Prize cards with the top card of your deck.

attacks.name: Juggling
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.

cards.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Psyjack
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Active Pokémon's attacks. That Pokémon can't use that attack during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Break Burn
attacks.text: Discard 2 Psychic Energy from this Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: This Pokémon was created by years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

cards.name: Machamp

attacks.name: Directing Traffic
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put them back in any order.

attacks.name: Cross Chop
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It grasps its opponents with its four arms and twists them up in an intricate hold. People call it "the Machamp special."

cards.name: Jigglypuff

attacks.name: Healing Melody
attacks.text: Heal 10 damage from each of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.

cards.name: Snubbull

attacks.name: Play Rough
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.

cards.name: Lickitung

attacks.name: Continuous Lick
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 20 damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!

cards.name: Ditto

attacks.name: Copy Anything
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon's attacks and use it as this attack. If this Pokémon doesn't have the necessary Energy to use that attack, this attack does nothing.

cards.flavorText: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.

cards.name: Slaking

attacks.name: Pitch
attacks.text: Your opponent switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.

cards.name: Dialga

attacks.name: Time Bellow
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Flash Cannon
attacks.text: You may return all Energy cards attached to Dialga to your hand. If you do, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from the Defending Pokémon and shuffle that card into your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Dusknoir

abilities.name: Dark Palm
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if your opponent has 4 or more Benched Pokémon, you may choose 1 of them and shuffle that Pokémon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck. This power can't be used if Dusknoir if affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hard Feelings
attacks.text: Put 5 damage counters on the Defending Pokémon. Then, count the number of Prize cards your opponent has taken and put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

cards.name: Electivire

abilities.name: Intense Voltage
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), if Elekid is anywhere under Electivire, you may move a Lightning Energy attached to your Pokémon to Electivire. This power can't be used if Electivire is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Giga Impact
attacks.text: You may discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electivire. If you do, this attack's base damage is 120 instead of 60.

cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

cards.name: Empoleon

attacks.name: Ice Blade
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Aqua Jet
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

cards.name: Infernape

attacks.name: Meteor Punch
attacks.text: Flip a coin until you get tails. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Flare Blitz
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy attached to Infernape.

cards.flavorText: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

cards.name: Lucario

attacks.name: Feint
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

attacks.name: Aura Sphere
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

cards.name: Luxray

abilities.name: Gleam Eyes
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Luxray from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at your opponent's hand. If your opponent's Bench isn't full, choose 1 Basic Pokémon from your opponent's hand, and put it onto his or her Bench. Then, switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Lightning Star
attacks.text: Move all Lightning Energy attached to Luxray to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. (Ignore this effect if you don't have any Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

cards.name: Magnezone

abilities.name: Magnetize
abilities.text: If you have any Metal Energy attached to your Active Pokémon, the Retreat Cost for that Pokémon is 0.

attacks.name: Metal Blast
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Metal Energy attached to Magnezone.

cards.flavorText: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

cards.name: Manaphy

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Aqua Ring
attacks.text: Switch Manaphy with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

cards.name: Mismagius

attacks.name: Avenge
attacks.text: Count the number of your Pokémon that have any damage counters on them. Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psywave
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

cards.name: Palkia

attacks.name: Spacial Rend
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Stadium card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward. If there is any Stadium card in play, discard it.

attacks.name: Transback
attacks.text: You may flip a coin. If heads, discard all Energy attached to Palkia and put the Defending Pokémon and all cards attached to it on top of your opponent's deck. Your opponent shuffles his or her deck afterward.

cards.flavorText: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

cards.name: Rhyperior

abilities.name: Earth Fissure
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Rhyperior from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Rock Wrecker
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance. Rhyperior can't attack during your next turn.

cards.flavorText: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

cards.name: Roserade

attacks.name: Poison Sting
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

attacks.name: Spike Whip
attacks.text: If Budew is anywhere under Roserade, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

cards.name: Shiftry

abilities.name: Darkness Fan
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Shiftry is your Active Pokémon, you may flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 Evolved Pokémon on your opponent's Bench, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from that Pokémon, and put it back into his or her hand. This power can't be used if Shiftry is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Spirit Dance
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

cards.flavorText: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.

cards.name: Skuntank

attacks.name: Frustration
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon that doesn't have any damage counters on it. This attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Toxic Cloud
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

cards.flavorText: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

cards.name: Staraptor

attacks.name: Accelerative Dive
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all damage done to Staraptor by attacks (both yours and your opponent's) until the end of your next turn.

attacks.name: Brave Heart
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Staraptor does 100 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

cards.name: Torterra

attacks.name: Body Slam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Leaf Storm
attacks.text: Remove 2 damage counters from each of your Grass Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

cards.name: Azumarill

attacks.name: Defense Curl
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Azumarill during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Bubble Pump
attacks.text: If Azumarill has 3 or more Energy attached to it, this attack does 40 damage plus 20 more damage. If Azurill is anywhere under Azumarill, flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

cards.name: Beautifly

attacks.name: Whirlwind
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Giga Drain
attacks.text: After your attack, remove from Beautifly the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.

cards.name: Bibarel

attacks.name: Rest
attacks.text: Remove all Special Conditions and 4 damage counters from Bibarel. Bibarel is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Bibarel does 10 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

cards.name: Carnivine

attacks.name: Swallow Up
attacks.text: Before doing damage, count the remaining HP of the Defending Pokémon and Carnivine. If the Defending Pokémon has fewer remaining HP than Carnivine's, this attack does 60 damage instead.

attacks.name: Wring Out
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

cards.name: Clefable

attacks.name: Double Slap
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Metronome
attacks.text: Choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon's attacks. Metronome copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else in order to use that attack.) Clefable performs that attack.

cards.flavorText: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

cards.name: Drapion

attacks.name: Stomp
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage.

attacks.name: Poison Claws
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

cards.name: Aggron

attacks.name: Heap Up
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for all Energy cards and show them to your opponent. If you find any Metal Special Energy cards there this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage. Put all of those Energy cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Hard Metal
attacks.text: You may do 60 damage plus 40 more damage. If you do, Aggron does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

cards.name: Alakazam

abilities.name: Power Cancel
abilities.text: Once during your opponent's turn, when your opponent's Pokémon uses any Poké-Power, you may discard 2 cards from your hand and prevent all effects of that Poké-Power. (This counts as that Pokémon using its Poké-Power.) This power can't be used if Alakazam is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Alakazam by attacks from your opponent's Stage 2 Evolved Pokémon is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.

cards.name: Ambipom

attacks.name: Tail Influence
attacks.text: Your opponent flips a coin until he or she gets heads. For each tails, remove an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and put it on the bottom of your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Charity Tail
attacks.text: Before Ambipom does damage, your opponent may discard 2 cards from his or her hand. If he or she does, this attack's base damage is 10 instead of 80.

cards.flavorText: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

cards.name: Azelf

abilities.name: Downer Material
abilities.text: If you have Uxie and Mesprit in play, the attack cost of each of your opponent's Basic Pokémon's attacks is Colorless more. You can't use more than 1 Downer Material Poké-Body each turn.

attacks.name: Bind Pulse
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can't attach any Special Energy cards from his or her hand to any of his or her Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

cards.name: Blissey

abilities.name: Kind Egg
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Happiny is anywhere under Blissey, you may choose a number of cards in your hand up to the amount of Energy attached to Blissey and put those cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward. Then, draw that many cards. This power can't be used if Blissey is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Happy Chance
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 for each Energy attached to Blissey. Before doing damage, you may search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to Blissey.

cards.flavorText: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

cards.name: Bronzong

abilities.name: Miracle Oracle
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may draw a card. Then, discard a card from your hand. If you discard an Energy card, draw 1 more card. This power can't be used if Bronzong is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Shady Stamp
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

cards.name: Celebi

attacks.name: Sprouting
attacks.text: Search your deck for a Grass Energy card and attach it to Celebi. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Leaf Tornado
attacks.text: You may move any number of basic Grass Energy cards attached to your Pokémon to your other Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: It has the power to travel across time, but is is said to appear only in peaceful times.

cards.name: Feraligatr

attacks.name: Energy Cyclone
attacks.text: Choose as many Energy cards from your hand as you like and show them to your opponent. This attack does 20 damage times the number of Energy cards you chose. Put those Energy cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Breaking Tail
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

cards.flavorText: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

cards.name: Garchomp

abilities.name: Rainbow Scale
abilities.text: If an Active Pokémon has Weakness to any of the types of Energy attached to Garchomp, Garchomp's attacks do 40 more damage to that Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Rainbow Scale Poké-Body can't be used if Garchomp has any Special Energy cards attached to it.

cards.flavorText: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

cards.name: Honchkrow

abilities.name: Dark Genes
abilities.text: As long as Honchkrow has the Energy necessary to use its attack, each of your Murkrow can use Honchkrow's attack as its own without the Energy necessary to use that attack.

attacks.name: Dark Wing Flaps
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at the card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

cards.flavorText: Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

cards.name: Lumineon

abilities.name: Lure Ring
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if Lumineon is your Active Pokémon, you may choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has a maximum HP of 100 or more and switch it with 1 of the Defending Pokémon. This power can't be used if Lumineon is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Reverse Stream
attacks.text: Does 30 damage plus 10 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Lumineon. Then, return all Water Energy attached to Lumineon to your hand.

cards.flavorText: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

cards.name: Magmortar

attacks.name: Smoke Bomb
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon tries to attack during your opponent's next turn, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does nothing.

attacks.name: Flame Drum
attacks.text: If Magby isn't anywhere under Magmortar, discard 2 Energy cards from your hand. (If you can't discard 2 Energy cards from your hand, this attack does nothing.)

cards.flavorText: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

cards.name: Meganium

attacks.name: Ultra Powder
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. If the first coin is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If the second coin is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned. If the third coin is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Fire Counterattack
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Fire Pokémon in play, this attack does 60 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

cards.name: Mesprit

abilities.name: Upper Material
abilities.text: If you have Uxie and Azelf in play, the Retreat Cost for each Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf (both yours and your opponent's) is 0.

attacks.name: Teleportation Burst
attacks.text: You may switch Mesprit with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

cards.name: Raichu

attacks.name: Electromagnetic Induction
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Explosive Thunder
attacks.text: Discard all basic Lightning Energy cards attached to Raichu. This attack does 30 damage times the number of Lightning Energy cards you discarded.

cards.flavorText: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.

cards.name: Typhlosion

abilities.name: Firestarter
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Fire Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. This power can't be used if Typhlosion is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Evaporating Heat
attacks.text: Discard a Water Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

cards.name: Ampharos

abilities.name: Jamming
abilities.text: After your opponent plays a Supporter card from his or her hand, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon. You can't use more than 1 Jamming Poké-Body each turn.

attacks.name: Cluster Bolt
attacks.text: You may discard all Lightning Energy attached to Ampharos. If you do, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any Energy cards attached to it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the tail's light.

cards.name: Blastoise

abilities.name: Waterlog
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach as many basic Water Energy cards from your hand to any of your Pokémon in any way you like. If you do, your turn ends. This power can't be used if Blastoise is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hydro Pump
attacks.text: Does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each Water Energy attached to Blastoise but not used to pay for this attack's Energy cost. You can't add more than 40 damage in this way.

cards.flavorText: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

cards.name: Charizard

abilities.name: Fury Blaze
abilities.text: If your opponent has 3 or less Prize cards left, each of Charizard's attacks does 50 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Blast Burn
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard. If tails, discard 4 Energy cards attached to Charizard. (If you can't, this attack does nothing.)

cards.flavorText: It is said that CHARIZARD's fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

cards.name: Entei

abilities.name: Burning Coat
abilities.text: Whenever 1 of your opponent's Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from Entei's attacks, discard the top 3 cards from your opponent's deck.

attacks.name: Blaze Roar
attacks.text: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Flip a coin. If tails, discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Entei.

cards.flavorText: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Flygon

abilities.name: Irritating Buzz
abilities.text: As long as Flygon is your Active Pokémon, put 1 damage counter on each of your opponent's Active Pokémon between turns, excluding Fighting Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sand Sonic
attacks.text: If you attach a Fighting Energy card from your hand to Flygon during this turn, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as "The Desert Spirit."

cards.name: Gallade

attacks.name: Sonic Blade
attacks.text: Put damage counters on the Defending Pokémon until it is 50 HP away from being Knocked Out. If you do, your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Psychic Cut
attacks.text: You may choose as many of your face-down Prize cards as you like and put them face up. If you do, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage for each Prize card you chose. (These cards remain face up for the rest of the game.)

cards.flavorText: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

cards.name: Gardevoir

abilities.name: Telepass
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your opponent's discard pile for a Supporter card and use the effect of that card as the effect of this power. (The Supporter card remains in your opponent's discard pile.) You can't use more than 1 Telepass Poké-Power each turn. This power can't be used if Gardevoir is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Psychic Lock
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, your opponent can't use any Poké-Powers on his or her Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

cards.name: Gastrodon East Sea

abilities.name: Osmotic Pressure
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), if you have Gastrodon West Sea in play, you may move up to 3 damage counters from Gastrodon East Sea to 1 of your Gastrodon West Sea.

attacks.name: Dwindling Wave
attacks.text: Does 80 damage minus 10 damage for each damage counter on Gastrodon East Sea.

cards.flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

cards.name: Gastrodon West Sea

attacks.name: Raging Flood
attacks.text: Does 20 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on Gastrodon West Sea. Then, remove 2 damage counters from Gastrodon West Sea.

attacks.name: Wild Waves
attacks.text: Put 1 damage counter on each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

cards.flavorText: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

cards.name: Ho-Oh

abilities.name: Phoenix Turn
abilities.text: Once during your opponent's turn, if Ho-Oh would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may flip a coin. If heads, Ho-Oh isn't discarded. Instead, remove all damage counter, Special Conditions, and other effects from Ho-Oh. Then, discard all cards attached to Ho-Oh (except for Energy cards). This counts as Ho-Oh being Knocked Out and your opponent takes a Prize card.

attacks.name: Rainbow Wing
attacks.text: This attack does 20 damage times the number of different types of basic Energy cards attached to Ho-Oh.

cards.flavorText: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

cards.name: Jumpluff

abilities.name: Cotton Spore
abilities.text: Whenever Jumpluff would be damaged by your opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Jumpluff by that attack.

attacks.name: Cottonweed Punch
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. For each heads, this attack does 30 damage to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

cards.name: Lickilicky

attacks.name: Tongue Reel
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. If you choose a Benched Pokémon, switch the Defending Pokémon with that Pokémon. This attack does 20 damage to the Pokémon you chose. Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Boundless Power
attacks.text: During your next turn, Lickilicky can't attack.

cards.flavorText: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting to close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

cards.name: Ludicolo

abilities.name: Rain Dish
abilities.text: At any time between turns, remove 1 damage counter from Ludicolo.

attacks.name: Nature Power
attacks.text: If you have a Stadium Card in play, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage. If your opponent has a Stadium card in play, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

cards.flavorText: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.

cards.name: Lugia

attacks.name: Silver Wing
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and return it to your opponent's hand.

attacks.name: Psychic Destruction
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has any Energy cards attached to it, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 120.

cards.flavorText: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

cards.name: Mew

attacks.name: Psychic Balance
attacks.text: If you have less cards in your hand than your opponent, draw cards until you have the same number of cards as your opponent. (If you have more or the same number of cards in your hand as your opponent, this attack does nothing.)

attacks.name: Re-creation
attacks.text: Choose an attack on 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in his or her discard pile. Re-creation copies that attack except for its Energy cost. (You must still do anything else required for that attack.) Mew performs that attack.

cards.flavorText: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe MEW to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

cards.name: Raikou

abilities.name: Thunder Rumble
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), when you attach a Lightning Energy card from your hand to Raikou, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Thunder Climb
attacks.text: Discard 3 cards from the top of your deck. This attack does 50 damage plus 10 more damage for each Lightning Energy card you discarded. Then, attach those Lightning Energy cards to 1 of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

cards.name: Roserade

attacks.name: Sleep Poison
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Magical Leaf
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage and remove 3 damage counters from Roserade.

cards.flavorText: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

cards.name: Salamence

attacks.name: Direct Hit
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness, Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Finish
attacks.text: Discard 2 basic Fire Energy cards or 2 basic Water Energy cards attached to Salamence. If you discarded 2 basic Fire Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to the Defending Pokémon. If you discarded 2 Basic Water Energy cards, this attack does 100 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (If you can't discard cards, this attack does nothing.)

cards.flavorText: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changes, and wings grew out.

cards.name: Suicune

abilities.name: Aqua Recover
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Suicune from your hand onto your Bench, you may search your discard pile for up to 3 Water Pokémon, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand.

attacks.name: Cure Stream
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done by attacks from the Defending Pokémon is reduced by 20 (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

cards.name: Venusaur

abilities.name: Miracle Aroma
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may flip a coin. If heads, choose either Asleep, Burned, or Poisoned. The Defending Pokémon is now affected by that Special Condition. This power can't be used if Venusaur is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Giant Bloom
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, remove 4 damage counters from Venusaur.

cards.flavorText: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

cards.name: Absol

attacks.name: Baleful Wind
attacks.text: Choose a card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it. If you discarded a Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium card, choose 1 more card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

attacks.name: Raid
attacks.text: If you played Absol from your hand during this turn, this attack's base damage is 40 instead of 10.

cards.flavorText: It senses disasters coming and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

cards.name: Arcanine

abilities.name: Flame Dash
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Arcanine from your hand to evolve 1 of your Benched Pokémon, you may switch Arcanine with 1 of your Active Pokémon. If you do, you may move any number of Energy cards attached to that Pokémon to Arcanine.

attacks.name: Inferno Onrush
attacks.text: Arcanine does 40 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

cards.name: Banette

attacks.name: Ghost Head
attacks.text: Put as many damage counters as you like on Banette. (You can't put more than Banette's remaining HP.) Put that many damage counters on the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spiteful Pain
attacks.text: If Banette is in your discard pile, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage, then search your discard pile for Banette, show it to your opponent, and shuffle it into your deck.

cards.flavorText: A doll that became a Pokémon over its grudge from being junked. It seeks the child that disowned it.

cards.name: Dugtrio

attacks.name: Dig Trap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Dugtrio during your opponent's next turn. If Dugtrio is your Active Pokémon at the end of your opponent's next turn, put 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pit Trap
attacks.text: Your opponent flips a coin. If tails, this attack does 50 damage plus 50 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Its three heads moves alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

cards.name: Electivire

abilities.name: Motor Drive
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Electivire. This power can't be used if Electivire is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy attached to Electivire. Flip a coin for each Lightning Energy you discarded. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

cards.name: Electrode

abilities.name: Energy Shift
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if Electrode would be Knocked Out by damage from an attack, you may use this power. Electrode isn't discarded. Instead, attach it as an Energy card to 1 of your Pokémon. While attached, this card is a Special Energy card and provides every type of Energy but provides only 1 Energy at a time. (Has no effect other than providing Energy.)

attacks.name: Ion Blast
attacks.text: You may do 40 damage plus 60 more damage. If you do, Electrode does 100 damage to itself.

cards.flavorText: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

cards.name: Furret

attacks.name: Keen Eye
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Baton Pass
attacks.text: You may switch Furret with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, move as many Energy cards attached to Furret as you like to the new Active Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

cards.name: Blaziken

attacks.name: Fire Dance
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Flame Kick
attacks.text: Discard 2 Fire Energy attached to Blaziken. This attack does 80 damage to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.

cards.name: Cresselia

attacks.name: Moon Twinkle
attacks.text: If there is any Stadium card in play, remove 2 damage counters from Cresselia.

attacks.name: Lunar Dance
attacks.text: You may discard 2 Energy attached to Cresselia. If you do, remove all damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Darkrai

attacks.name: Reach Over
attacks.text: Search your deck for an Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Darkness Pursuit
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Cresselia, this attack's base damage is 100.

cards.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Darkrai

attacks.name: Darkness Roar
attacks.text: You may have your opponent switch the Defending Pokémon with 1 or his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Sleep Hole
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep, this attack does 40 damage plus 40 more damage. If the Defending Pokémon is not Asleep, that Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Pachirisu

attacks.name: Call for Family
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Smash Short
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool card attached to it, this attack does 10 damage plus 30 more damage. Discard that Pokémon Tool card, look at your opponent's hand, and discard any Pokémon Tool cards of the same name you find there.

cards.flavorText: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

cards.name: Porygon-Z

abilities.name: Conversion
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard a basic Energy card from your hand. Porygon-Z is the same type as that Energy Card until the end of your turn. This power can't be used if Porygon-Z is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Tri Attack
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 40 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

cards.name: Rotom

attacks.name: Astonish
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking. Look at that card you chose, then have your opponent shuffle that card into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Telebeam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 30 more damage and the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

cards.flavorText: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

cards.name: Sceptile

abilities.name: Wild Growth
abilities.text: Each basic Grass Energy card attached to your Grass Pokémon provides GrassGrass Energy instead. You can't use more than 1 Wild Growth Poké-Body each turn.

attacks.name: Leaf Blade
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.flavorText: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

cards.name: Swampert

abilities.name: Wash Out
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Water or Fighting Energy attached to 1 of your Benched Pokémon to your Active Pokémon. This power can't be used if Swampert is affected by a Special Condition.

attacks.name: Hammer Arm
attacks.text: Discard the top card from your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

cards.name: Tangrowth

attacks.name: Power Whip
attacks.text: Choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 10 damage for each basic Energy card attached to Tangrowth to that Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Stick and Absorb
attacks.text: Remove 3 damage counters from Tangrowth. The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Togekiss

abilities.name: Serene Grace
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you play Togekiss from your hand to evolve 1 of your Pokémon, you may look at the top 10 cards of your deck, choose as many basic Energy cards as you like, and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Put the other cards back on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Air Scroll
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage. If tails, remove 3 damage counters from Togekiss.

cards.flavorText: It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

cards.name: Altaria

attacks.name: Dragonbreath
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Cotton Cloud
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Altaria by attacks from your opponent's Evolved Pokémon is reduced by 30 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: It looks like a fluffy cloud when it is in flight. It hums with its soprano voice.

cards.name: Beedrill

attacks.name: Band Attack
attacks.text: Does 30 damage times the number of Beedrill you have in play.

attacks.name: Twineedle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage times the number of heads.

cards.flavorText: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

cards.name: Butterfree

attacks.name: Parallel Drain
attacks.text: After your attack, remove from 1 of your Pokémon the number of damage counters equal to the damage you did to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dozing Scales
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned.

cards.flavorText: It loves the honey of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

cards.name: Claydol

abilities.name: Cosmic Power
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may choose up to 2 cards from your hand and put them on the bottom of your deck in any order. If you do, draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand. This power can't be used if Claydol is affected by a Special Condition.

cards.flavorText: An ancient clay figurine that came to life as a Pokémon from exposure to a mysterious ray of light.

cards.name: Dialga

attacks.name: Time Bellow
attacks.text: Draw a card.

attacks.name: Flash Cannon
attacks.text: You may return all Energy cards attached to Dialga to your hand. If you do, remove the highest Stage Evolution card from the Defending Pokémon and shuffle that card into your opponent's deck.

cards.flavorText: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

cards.name: Exploud

attacks.name: Ambient Noise
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If the first coin is heads, this attack does 50 damage to the Defending Pokémon. If the first coin is tails, this attack does 20 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) If the second coin is heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused. If the second coin is tails, your opponent can't play any Trainer, Supporter, or Stadium cards from his or her hand during your opponent's next turn.

cards.flavorText: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

cards.name: Houndoom

attacks.name: Dark Fang
attacks.text: Choose 1 card from your opponent's hand without looking and discard it.

attacks.name: Black Fire
attacks.text: You may discard a Fire or Darkness Energy attached to Houndoom. If you discard a Fire Energy, the Defending Pokémon is now Burned. If you discard a Darkness Energy, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage.

cards.flavorText: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

cards.name: Hypno

attacks.name: Dream Catcher
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep, move all damage counters from Hypno to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Hypnoblast
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

cards.flavorText: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even if someone just woke up.

cards.name: Articuno

abilities.name: Freezing Screech
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Articuno from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon. That Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Blizzard
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. If tails, this attack does 10 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: A legendary bird Pokémon. It can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

cards.name: Cresselia

attacks.name: Future Sight
attacks.text: Look at the top 5 cards of either player's deck and put them back on top of that player's deck in any order.

attacks.name: Healing Light
attacks.text: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

cards.name: Darkrai

abilities.name: Darkness Shade
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Darkrai from your hand onto your Bench, you may choose 1 of the Defending Pokémon. That Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Dark Slumber
attacks.text: At the end of your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

attacks.name: Dark Resolve
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon is Asleep, remove 4 damage counters from Darkrai.

cards.flavorText: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

cards.name: Dialga
rules: Adamant Orb: If an Active Pokémon has Weakness to Metal type, Dialga's attacks do 20 more damage to that Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Time Shift
attacks.text: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.

attacks.name: Diamond Blast
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 60 damage plus 20 more damage.

cards.name: Glaceon

attacks.name: Snow Cloak
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of an attack, including damage, done to Glaceon during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Speed Slide
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance, Poké-Powers, Poké-Bodies, or any other effects on the Defending Pokémon.

cards.flavorText: As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

cards.name: Kabutops

abilities.name: Primal Shell
abilities.text: As long as Kabutops is your Active Pokémon, your opponent can't play any Trainer cards from his or her hand.

attacks.name: Chop Up
attacks.text: Does 10 damage to each of your opponent's Benched Pokémon that has any damage counters on it. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

cards.flavorText: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

cards.name: Leafeon

attacks.name: Bind Down
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

attacks.name: Leaf Guard
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Leafeon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

cards.flavorText: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

cards.name: Manaphy

abilities.name: Aqua Skin
abilities.text: When you attach a Water Energy card from your hand to Manaphy, remove 2 damage counters from Manaphy.

attacks.name: Chase Up
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for any 1 card and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Fountain
attacks.text: You may attach up to 2 basic Water Energy cards from your hand to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like.

cards.flavorText: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

cards.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Energy Absorption
attacks.text: Search your discard pile for up to 2 Energy cards and attach them to Mewtwo.

attacks.name: Recover
attacks.text: Discard a Psychic Energy attached to Mewtwo and remove 6 damage counters from Mewtwo.

cards.flavorText: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Moltres

abilities.name: Flame Charge
abilities.text: Once during your turn, when you put Moltres from your hand onto your Bench, you may flip a coin. If heads, search your discard pile for up to 3 Fire Energy cards and attach them to Moltres.

attacks.name: Scorching Wing
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy attached to Moltres.

cards.flavorText: One of the legendary bird Pokémon. It is said that its appearance indicates the coming of spring.

cards.name: Palkia
rules: Lustrous Orb: If an Active Pokémon has Weakness to Water type, Palkia's attacks do 20 more damage to that Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).

attacks.name: Zone Shift
attacks.text: Your opponent switches the Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon.

attacks.name: Pearl Blast
attacks.text: You may return an Energy card attached to Palkia to your hand. If you do, choose an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon and return it to your opponent's hand.

cards.name: Phione

attacks.name: Mega Drain
attacks.text: If Erika's Vileplume does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), remove a number of damage counters from Erika's Vileplume equal to half the damage done to the Defending Pokémon (rounded up to the nearest 10). If Erika's Vileplume has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.

attacks.name: Charge
attacks.text: Take up to 2 Lightning Energy cards from your discard pile and attach them to Lt. Surge's Electabuzz.

attacks.name: Discharge
attacks.text: Discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to Lt. Surge's Electabuzz in order to use this attack. Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Lightning Energy cards you discarded. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Repeating Drill
attacks.text: Flip 5 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Clutch
attacks.text: The Defending Pokémon can't retreat during your opponent's next turn.

abilities.name: Energy Charge
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), if Lt. Surge's Magneton is your Active Pokémon, you may take 1 Lightning Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon and attach it to Lt. Surge's Magneton. This power can't be used if Lt. Surge's Magneton is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Mega Shock
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, Lt. Surge's Magneton does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Knockout Needle
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 30 damage plus 60 more damage. If 1 or both of them are tails, this attack does 30 damage.

abilities.name: Flee
abilities.text: If an attack does damage to Misty's Tentacruel while it's your Active Pokémon, you may switch it with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, which prevents all other effects of that attack on Misty's Tentacruel. This power can't be used if Misty's Tentacruel is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Jellyfish Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. If tails, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

attacks.name: Crosscounter
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to Rocket's Hitmonchan during your opponent's next turn (even if Rocket's Hitmonchan is Knocked Out), flip a coin. If heads, Rocket's Hitmonchan attacks your opponent's Active Pokémon for double that amount of damage. (If Rocket's Hitmonchan takes 20 damage, it does 40 damage to that Pokémon.)

abilities.name: Rebirth
abilities.text: When Rocket's Moltres is Knocked Out, you may return it to your hand after discarding it. This power can't be used if Rocket's Moltres is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed when it is Knocked Out.

attacks.name: Fire Wall
attacks.text: If an attack does damage to Rocket's Moltres during your opponent's next turn (even if Rocket's Moltres is Knocked Out), Rocket's Moltres attacks your opponent's Active Pokémon for 10 damage. (Apply Weakness and Resistance.)

attacks.name: Shadow Images
attacks.text: Whenever Rocket's Scyther is attacked, your opponent flips a coin. If tails, that attack does no damage to Rocket's Scyther. (Any other effects of the attack still happen.) This effect lasts until Rocket's Scyther takes damage (or is Benched or is evolved).

attacks.name: Pain Amplifier
attacks.text: Put a damage counter on each of your opponent's Pokémon has already has any damage counters on it.

attacks.name: Call of the Night
attacks.text: Unless this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokémon, flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, your opponent shuffles his or her Active Pokémon and all cards attached to it into his or her deck.

cards.name: Brock
rules: Remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon that has any damage counters on it.

cards.name: Erika
rules: You may draw up to 3 cards, then your opponent may draw up to 3 cards.

cards.name: Lt. Surge
rules: You can play this card only if you have at least 1 Basic Pokémon card in your hand. Put a Basic Pokémon card from your hand into play as your Active Pokémon. Put your old Active Pokémon onto your Bench. (You can't play this card if your Bench is full.)

cards.name: Misty
rules: Discard 2 of the other cards in your hand in order to play this card. If this turn's attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and if the attacking Pokémon has Misty in its name, the attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

cards.name: The Rocket's Trap
rules: Flip a coin. If heads, choose up to 3 cards at random from your opponent's hand (don't look at them). Your opponent shuffles those cards into his or her deck.

attacks.name: Rock Slide
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose up to 3 of them. This attack does 10 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Bind
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Tunneling
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose up to 2 of them. This attack does 20 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) Brock's Onix can't attack during your next turn.

attacks.name: Horn Toss
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, he or she chooses 1 of them and switches it with the Defending Pokémon. (Do the damage before switching the Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Take Down
attacks.text: Brock's Rhyhorn does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Heat Tackle
attacks.text: Blaine's Arcanine does 10 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Firestorm
attacks.text: Discard 3 Fire Energy cards attached to Blaine's Arcanine in order to use this attack.

attacks.name: Roaring Flames
attacks.text: Discard all Fire Energy cards attached to Blaine's Charizard. If all Energy cards attached to Blaine's Charizard provide 2 Fire Energy, discard all of them. This attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage for each Fire Energy discarded in this way.

attacks.name: Flame Jet
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 40 damage to that Pokémon. Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack. (Any other effects that would happen after applying Weakness and Resistance still happen.)

abilities.name: Shapeshift
abilities.text: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may attach an Evolution card from your hand to Brock's Ninetales. (This doesn't count as evolving Brock's Ninetales.) Treat Brock's Ninetales as if it were that Pokémon instead. It can't evolve, devolve, or use the Pokémon Power of that Pokémon. During your turn, you may discard the Evolution card attached to Brock's Ninetales. This power can't be used if Brock's Ninetales is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed. If Brock's Ninetales becomes Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed, discard all Evolution cards attached to it.

attacks.name: Growth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, you may attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to Erika's Venusaur.

attacks.name: Wide Solarbeam
attacks.text: If your opponent has any Benched Pokémon, choose 2 of them (or 1 if he or she only has 1). This attack does 20 damage to each of them. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

attacks.name: Summon Storm
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 damage to each other Pokémon (even your own). Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for this attack.

attacks.name: Dragon Tornado
attacks.text: Unless this attack Knocks Out the Defending Pokémon, choose 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon and switch it with the Defending Pokémon.

abilities.name: Fortitude
abilities.text: If Giovanni's Machamp would be Knocked Out by an opponent's attack, flip a coin. If heads, Giovanni's Machamp is not Knocked Out and its remaining HP become 10 instead. This power can't be used if Giovanni's Machamp is already Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Hurricane Punch
attacks.text: Flip 4 coins. This attack does 30 damage times the number of heads.

attacks.name: Intimidate
attacks.text: If the Defending Pokémon's maximum HP is 50 or less, it can't attack Giovanni's Nidoking during your opponent's next turn. (Benching or evolving either Pokémon ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Tumbling Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 40 damage plus 30 more damage; if tails, this attack does 40 damage.

abilities.name: Call the Boss
abilities.text: When you play Giovanni's Persian from your hand, you may search your deck for the Trainer card named Giovanni, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

attacks.name: Ambush
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 20 more damage; if tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Nerve Poison
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Hyper Needle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing. Either way, you can't use this attack again as long as Koga's Beedrill stays in play (even putting Koga's Beedrill on the Bench won't let you use it again).

attacks.name: Giant Growth
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, Koga's Ditto's maximum HP is now 80 and Koga's Ditto's Pound attack's base damage is 30 instead of 10. (Benching Koga's Ditto ends this effect.)

attacks.name: Kerzap
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 30 more damage to the Defending Pokémon and discard all Lightning Energy cards attached to Lt. Surge's Raichu. If tails, this attack does 20 damage.

attacks.name: Thundertackle
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Paralyzed. If tails, Lt. Surge's Raichu does 20 damage to itself.

attacks.name: Electro Beam
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, discard all Energy cards attached to Misty's Golduck.

attacks.name: Super Removal
